units: <cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 16:7">Kel. XVI, 7</cite> Ar. <cite ref="A02249"><he>אנלגין</he></cite> (Var. in R. S. <he>אנליגין</he>, ed. <cite ref="A02103"><he>אנגלין</he></cite>; corr. acc.). Y. Meg. III, 73ᵈ bot. <he>אנג׳</he>, <he>אינג׳</he> (corr. acc.).

<cite ref="Tosefta Kelim Kamma 2:3">Tosef. Kel. B. Kam. II, 3</cite> <he>או לולגין פרוס׳ וכ׳</he> ed. Zuck. (Var. <he>אלו לגין</he>, ed. <he>אולו לוגין</he> read <he>אנאלוגין</he>; used as fem.) a reading desk spread out is clean, folded together is unclean (susceptible of levitical uncleanness).
